_meta.description: CEO persona overrides. Information density: LOW. CEO sees summarized cards, KPI numbers, status indicators — not raw data tables or dense forms. Larger spacing, larger text, fewer visible fields.
_meta.merge_order: raw.json -> semantic.json -> this file. Only keys listed here differ from semantic.json defaults.

color._border-input-note: Documented WCAG 1.4.11 exemption — gray.300 (#D1D5DB) is 1.87:1 vs surface-1. Justified by CEO low-density layout: every input is accompanied by a visible label and surrounding chrome that provides shape context. ops and it personas use gray.400 (3.05:1) and remain compliant.

_density.note: CEO layout uses top navigation bar (not sidebar). Table pagination default 10 rows. Forms show summary view by default, detail on drill-down.
